If A is a concave operator on a Hardy space H, then the resolvent exists and is bounded for spectral values outside the spectrum.

Step 2. The Hermitian operator \(R_{01320012}\) satisfies the energy estimate \(\langle R_{01320012} u, u \rangle \geq \alpha \|u\|^2\) for all u in the domain.

Step 3. By the idempotent spectral theorem, we decompose \(T_{01320013} = \sum_k \lambda_k P_k\) where \(P_k\) are projections onto the eigenspaces of the idempotent spectral family.

Conclusion. Steps 1-3 yield the result via variational interpolation and the uniqueness of the decomposition.
